objective: Verify whether the V17 market-momentum timing rule (hold V16 ungated when the prior 20-trading-day benchmark return is positive, otherwise cash) holds out-of-sample over 126 untouched trading days from 2026-08-27.
parent: stockpilot-v17-market-momentum-timing-over-v16 (lock F999B893 then re-frozen as 7D798E94 after dependency correction)

timing_rule.look_ahead_guard: the signal at day T uses only benchmark returns through day T-1 (inclusive), known at the T close

benchmark_definition.note: The retrospective V17 validation used the equal-weighted CSI300 constituent return. The shadow test uses the CSI300 index (000300) close-to-close return as a simpler, unambiguous proxy; this is an approximation and is recorded as a limitation.
benchmark_definition.source: local daily bars from data/shadow/bars and the frozen market history

evaluation.cadence: every trading day, one immutable decision record

decision_rule.all_gates_passed: the timing rule is promoted to paper-trade candidate only; still no automatic execution
decision_rule.any_gate_failed: the retrospective +339 percent excess is judged an overfit; decision returns to keep_v6
decision_rule.immutable: decision records are append-only and sha256-chained

limitations: index-based benchmark proxy differs from the equal-weighted retrospective benchmark
requires daily market data ingestion which depends on network access to the data provider
a conclusion is only reachable after 126 trading days
